name: shadcn/ui
tags: shadcn|components|tailwind|copy paste|open code|radix|base ui|design system|nextjs ui|accessible
description: Open-code Tailwind component collection copied into your repo (components/ui) via a CLI, built on Radix or Base UI; the default pick for a React/Next site you want to fully own and restyle.
setup_notes: Needs Tailwind CSS v4 and a tsconfig path alias (@/* -> ./* or ./src/*). init asks for Radix or Base UI; component imports are identical either way (@/components/ui/<name>). Add components with npx shadcn@latest add <name>.

name: Radix Primitives
description: Unstyled, accessible React primitives (dialog, menus, popover, tabs, navigation menu...) in one tree-shakable package; pick it when you want to write all the styling yourself.
setup_notes: Single package: import { Dialog } from "radix-ui" then use Dialog.Root / Dialog.Trigger / etc. Per-part import also works: import * as Popover from "radix-ui/popover". Unstyled: style via data-state attributes.

name: Base UI
description: Unstyled accessible React components from the MUI/Radix/Floating UI team (combobox, drawer, toast, navigation menu, menus...); pick it for a modern headless base with more components than Radix.
setup_notes: Import per component: import { Dialog } from '@base-ui/react/dialog'. Add .root { isolation: isolate } to the app root wrapper so portaled popups stack above content; for iOS 26+ Safari add body { position: relative }. Package was previously @base-ui-components/react.

name: React Aria Components
description: Adobe's unstyled, deeply accessible and internationalized component library (date pickers, combobox, table, drag and drop); pick it when accessibility, keyboard and locale support matter most.
setup_notes: Docs import from per-component subpaths, e.g. import {Select, SelectValue} from 'react-aria-components/Select' (the package root also exports everything). Components are client-only. Style via render props or data attributes; docs offer vanilla CSS and Tailwind starters.

name: Headless UI
description: Tailwind Labs' small set of unstyled, accessible React components designed to pair with Tailwind CSS; pick it for simple menus, dialogs, listboxes and disclosures in a Tailwind project.
setup_notes: Components expose data-* state attributes (data-open, data-focus, data-selected) for Tailwind styling and a transition prop for enter/leave animation.

name: Mantine
description: Large fully styled React component library (120+ components, hooks, dates, carousel, notifications, spotlight) themed with CSS variables; pick it for feature-rich apps and dashboards without Tailwind.
setup_notes: Import '@mantine/core/styles.css' at the root and wrap the app in <MantineProvider>. Install postcss postcss-preset-mantine postcss-simple-vars and add postcss.config.cjs. Extension packages (@mantine/dates, @mantine/carousel, @mantine/notifications, @mantine/spotlight) each need their own styles.css import after core styles. Current major: v9.

name: HeroUI
description: Styled, animated React component library (formerly NextUI) built on Tailwind CSS v4 and React Aria; pick it for a polished look out of the box with accessible behavior.
setup_notes: v3 requires React 19+ and Tailwind CSS v4. In the main CSS file add @import "tailwindcss"; then @import "@heroui/styles"; (order matters). No Provider needed. Components use compound dot notation (Modal.Backdrop, Modal.Dialog...).

name: Chakra UI
description: Styled, themeable React component system (v3, built on Ark UI/Zag state machines) with carousel, marquee and date picker; pick it for a prop-styled design system with strong theming.
setup_notes: Wrap the app in the generated <Provider> from @/components/ui/provider (ChakraProvider + next-themes). Set tsconfig module ESNext, moduleResolution Bundler, and paths @/*. Some components (toaster, tooltip) are CLI snippets imported from @/components/ui/*. Node 20+.

name: Ark UI (React)
description: Headless, accessible components driven by Zag.js state machines (carousel, date picker, marquee, floating panel, combobox...); pick it for unstyled parts beyond what Radix offers.
setup_notes: Import per component subpath: import { Dialog } from '@ark-ui/react/dialog'. Unstyled; style via data-part / data-state attributes. Use <Portal> from '@ark-ui/react/portal' for overlays.

name: Magic UI
description: Free, open-source animated components for landing pages (marquee, bento grid, number ticker, beams, grid/dot backgrounds, text effects) installed as shadcn registry items; pick it for showpiece marketing sections.
setup_notes: Requires a shadcn/ui setup (Tailwind v4, components.json). Files land in components/ui; the CLI installs deps such as motion. Some components need CSS keyframes in globals.css (see each page). Magic UI Pro is a separate paid product and is not listed here.

name: Aceternity UI
description: Flashy Tailwind + Motion components for hero sections and landing pages (aurora, beams, spotlight, sparkles, parallax, animated navbars) installed via the shadcn CLI; pick it for high-impact marketing visuals.
setup_notes: Requires a shadcn/ui-style setup (Tailwind v4, @/ alias); files land in components/ui and deps (usually motion) are installed by the CLI. License: free for unlimited personal and commercial projects, but redistribution/resale as a competing library is not allowed. Pro components are paid and excluded here.

name: Motion Primitives
tags: motion primitives|motion|animated|text effect|morphing dialog|infinite slider|tilt|magnetic|micro interaction
description: Open-source kit of small motion-driven UI building blocks (text effects, morphing dialog, infinite slider, animated numbers, tilt, spotlight); pick it for tasteful micro-interactions in Tailwind projects.
install: npm install motion && npx motion-primitives@latest add <component>
setup_notes: Requires Tailwind CSS and motion (some components also need lucide-react or react-use-measure). The motion-primitives CLI writes components/motion-primitives/<name>.tsx; the shadcn alternative (npx shadcn@latest add "https://motion-primitives.com/c/<name>.json") writes components/ui/<name>.tsx instead, so adjust the import path.

name: React Bits
description: Large free collection of animated text effects, WebGL/shader backgrounds and interactive components, each in JS/TS and CSS/Tailwind variants; pick it for bold creative backgrounds and text animations.
setup_notes: Variant suffix is <LANG>-<STYLE>: JS|TS and CSS|TW (jsrepo also works: npx jsrepo@latest add <same url>). Components are default exports; docs import them relatively (import SplitText from "./SplitText"), so adjust to wherever the CLI placed the file. Deps vary per component (gsap, motion, ogl, three). License is MIT + Commons Clause (free to use in projects, not to resell the components); React Bits Pro is separate and paid.

name: Sonner
description: Opinionated, animated toast notifications for React with a one-line API; pick it for app-wide toasts (shadcn/ui uses it).
setup_notes: Render <Toaster /> once near the app root, then call toast('...') anywhere. shadcn/ui wraps it as npx shadcn@latest add sonner.

name: Vaul
description: Unstyled drawer / bottom-sheet component for React with drag-to-dismiss and snap points (built on Radix Dialog); pick it for mobile-style sheets.
setup_notes: The repository is marked unmaintained by its author (still widely used; shadcn/ui Drawer wraps it). Prefer Base UI Drawer for new work if you need an actively maintained option. Docs show pnpm i vaul.

name: cmdk
description: Fast, unstyled, composable command-menu (Cmd+K palette) component for React; pick it for command palettes and searchable action lists.
setup_notes: Unstyled; style via [cmdk-*] attributes. Command.Dialog renders it in a Radix Dialog. shadcn/ui wraps it as npx shadcn@latest add command. README shows pnpm install cmdk.

name: Embla Carousel (React)
description: Lightweight headless carousel engine with a React hook and plugins (autoplay, auto-scroll, fade); pick it for fully custom sliders (shadcn and Mantine carousels use it).
setup_notes: Headless: you supply the markup/CSS (.embla__viewport overflow hidden; .embla__container display flex; .embla__slide flex 0 0 100%, min-width 0). Plugins install separately (embla-carousel-autoplay, etc.).

name: React DayPicker
description: Customizable date picker / calendar component with single, multiple and range selection; pick it for inline calendars or to build a popover date picker.
setup_notes: Import the stylesheet: import "@daypicker/react/style.css". v10 is published as @daypicker/react (current docs) and also under the older name react-day-picker (same version); shadcn/ui Calendar is built on it.

name: TanStack Table
description: Headless table/datagrid logic (sorting, filtering, pagination, selection, grouping) that you render with your own markup; pick it for data tables.
setup_notes: v9 API: register features with tableFeatures({...}) and create the table with useTable (v8 used useReactTable/getCoreRowModel; see the migration guide). Works with React 18+. shadcn/ui Data Table is a styled recipe on top of it.

name: coss ui (formerly Origin UI)
description: Tailwind component collection built on Base UI and distributed through the shadcn CLI; Origin UI's successor, pick it for shadcn-style open code on a Base UI foundation.
setup_notes: Existing shadcn projects: npx shadcn@latest add @coss/ui (all primitives) or add single components with npx shadcn@latest add @coss/<name>. Components land in components/ui. The apps/ui directory is MIT (the rest of the coss monorepo is AGPL).
